description: Work with your SamCart store: find orders, charges, refunds, failed payments, customers and abandoned checkouts, refund charges, cancel, pause, restart and discount subscriptions, and create products and coupons. Start workflows on new orders, payments, refunds, failed payments, subscriptions and cancellations.

samcart_new_charge_trigger.description: Runs for each successful payment: a first payment at checkout or a subscription's rebill. Choose subscription rebills to run only when a subscription is charged. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.card_used: The card's brand and last four digits.
output.id: The charge's id, for Get charge or Refund charge.

parameters.description: one_time for first payments, recurring for subscription rebills, limited for limited-subscription payments. Leave empty for every charge.
parameters.name: charge_type

samcart_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs for each new customer in your SamCart marketplace. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The customer's id, for Get customer.
output.test_mode: True if they came from a test-mode checkout.

samcart_new_failed_charge_trigger.description: Runs for each payment that fails, at checkout or on a subscription rebill, with the processor's reason. Choose rebills only to watch subscriptions alone. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.card_used: The card's brand and last four digits.
output.error: Why it failed, as the processor said.
output.order_id: The order, if there is one.
output.source: The payment method: card, paypal and so on.
output.subscription_id: The subscription, for a failed rebill.

parameters.description: true to run only for failed subscription payments. Leave empty for every failed payment.
parameters.name: rebills_only

samcart_new_order_trigger.description: Runs for each new order in your SamCart marketplace, including test-mode orders, with its total, status, customer and products. Orders already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.cart_items: Each product: product_id, product_name, sku, quantity, status and subscription_id.
output.customer: The customer's id, first_name, last_name and email.
output.id: The order's id, for Get order.
output.payment_method: card, paypal, klarna and so on.
output.status: charged, pending, declined, refunded and so on.
output.total: What was charged, in cents (4999 is 49.99).

parameters.description: Only orders that include this product. Leave empty for every order.
parameters.name: product_id

samcart_new_prospect_trigger.description: Runs for each prospect: someone who entered their details on a checkout without buying. SamCart records one per product. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.product_id: The product whose checkout they started.
output.test_mode: True if the checkout was in test mode.

parameters.description: Only for this product. Leave empty for every product.
parameters.name: product_id

samcart_new_refund_trigger.description: Runs for each refund, full or partial, of an order or a subscription payment. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.amount: How much was refunded, in cents.
output.charge_id: The charge refunded, for Get charge.
output.test_mode: True if the charge was in test mode.

samcart_new_subscription_trigger.description: Runs for each new subscription, with its product, price, interval, customer and next payment. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.customer: The customer's id, first_name, last_name and email.
output.id: The subscription's id, for Get subscription.
output.price: What each payment charges, in cents.
output.status: active, canceled, delinquent, completed and so on.
output.subscription_interval: weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly or days.
output.times_rebilled: How many times it has billed again.

parameters.description: Only for this product. Leave empty for every product.
parameters.name: product_id

samcart_subscription_ended_trigger.description: Runs when a subscription is canceled (by you, the customer, or after too many failed payments) or a limited subscription completes. Get subscription gives its end date. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.customer: The customer's id, first_name, last_name and email.
output.id: The subscription's id, for Get subscription.
output.price: What each payment charges, in cents.
output.status: active, canceled, delinquent, completed and so on.
output.subscription_interval: weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly or days.
output.times_rebilled: How many times it has billed again.

parameters.description: canceled for cancellations only, completed for finished limited subscriptions only. Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Only for this product. Leave empty for every product.
parameters.name: product_id
